statement: ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : X n × ℝ → F) (c : F) (O : Set (X n × ℝ)), IsOpen O → EqOn f (fun _ => c) O → EqOn (dt f) (fun _ => 0) O ∧ ∀ j, EqOn (dx f j) (fun _ => 0) O
proof:
intro F _ _ f c O hO he
constructor
· intro p hp
  have ht : (fun r : ℝ => f (p.1,r)) =ᶠ[nhds p.2] (fun _ => c) := by
    have hh : O ∈ nhds (p.1,p.2) := hO.mem_nhds hp
    filter_upwards [(continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hh] with r hr
    exact he hr
  simpa only [dt, deriv_const] using ht.deriv_eq
· intro j p hp
  have ht : (fun y : X n => f (y,p.2)) =ᶠ[nhds p.1] (fun _ => c) := by
    have hh : O ∈ nhds (p.1,p.2) := hO.mem_nhds hp
    filter_upwards [(continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hh] with y hy
    exact he hy
  change (fderiv ℝ (fun y : X n => f (y,p.2)) p.1) (Pi.single j 1) = 0
  rw [ht.fderiv_eq]
  simp

  1 ≤ n ∧ 1 ≤ m →

        (∀ (s t : ℝ), 0 < s → s < t → ∃ C, IsCompact C ∧ ∀ x ∉ C, ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, u (x, r) = q) →
          (∀ (t0 : ℝ),
              0 < t0 →
                ∃ C R,
                  IsCompact C ∧
                    0 < R ∧
                      (∀ x ∈ C, ∀ (j : Fin n), x j ∈ Ioo (-R) R) ∧
                        ∀ x ∉ C, ∀ r ∈ Icc (t0 / 2) (3 * t0 / 2), u (x, r) = q) →
            ∀ {F : Type} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ F] (f : X n × ℝ → F) (c : F)
              (O : Set (X n × ℝ)),
              IsOpen O →
                EqOn f (fun x => c) O → EqOn (dt f) (fun x => 0) O ∧ ∀ (j : Fin n), EqOn (dx f j) (fun x => 0) O
